subject: Subject deleted from study - still receiving notifications
body:
Dear Mohammad,

Yesterday, I enrolled a participant in the study and later ‘deleted’ them in agreement as they will start their measurement period at a later time point.
However, this morning the participant emailed me that they received a notification/questionnaire this morning which should not have been the case.

Could you please check why this participant is still receiving notifications? And possibly further delete/drop this participant from our study?

As for the moment I cannot see/edit a ‘history of my actions’ in Avicenna, thus cannot check or change anything for the participants participation.

Study ID: 3345

Participant ID: 103817

Thank you very much for prioritizing this issue as for the participant it is quite frustrating, they are receiving notifications when it was agreed that start of participation would be delayed due to personal circumstances.

Best regards,

Eva Vanbrabant

subject: Subject deleted from study - still receiving notifications
body:
Dear Eva,

Thank you for your patience while I investigated the issue.

It appears that your participant hasn't reloaded their studies on their mobile app, as there are no such events in your study logs. This likely means they haven't opened their app recently while connected to the internet since the "Study Reload" happens automatically after a participant is deleted from the study.

Could you please instruct them to reload their studies in the app and check if the issue is resolved? Let me know if they encounter the issue again.

Regarding your concern:
> "As for the moment I cannot see/edit a ‘history of my actions’ in Avicenna, thus cannot check or change anything for the participants' participation."

You can view the history of your actions on the "Audit Trails" page in your researcher dashboard. I could see all the events for this user there, including a log for deleting the participant, but no study reload.

You can learn more about this feature on our Learn website:
https://learn.avicennaresearch.com/reference/study-setup-and-deployment/audit-trail/


Best regards,
AmirMohammad

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25154/4007bea4cb06b868
